schoolLevelManual.title: How to generate school level certificates
schoolLevelManual.subtitle: A step-by-step guide for contingent managers. The pictures are illustrations of the screens you will see.
schoolLevelManual.before1: The section appears only after the organiser has set the certificate template and opened certificates to the Manager Portal. If you do not see it, check again later.
schoolLevelManual.before2: Each participant can receive one school level certificate per competition. A certificate cannot be issued twice.
schoolLevelManual.before3: Check the names and classes of your participants first (Peserta page). Names are printed on the certificate exactly as they are saved.
schoolLevelManual.s1Title: Open the School Level Cert page
schoolLevelManual.s1Body: Go to Sijil in the sidebar. At the top you will find the SCHOOL LEVEL CERT card (CONTINGENT LEVEL CERT for non-school contingents). Press Open.
schoolLevelManual.s2Body: The competitions are listed on the left with how many participants are registered, eligible and already issued. Use the search box to find one quickly, then click it.
schoolLevelManual.s3Body: Every eligible participant of your contingent is listed. Participants registered or taking part in the competition at any level are ticked for you. Tick or untick names as needed.
schoolLevelManual.s3Legend1: Registered — ticked by default, with the team (or Walk-in) they took part under.
schoolLevelManual.s3Legend2: Eligible — meets the competition's category but is not registered. Tick to include.
schoolLevelManual.s3Legend3: Already issued — greyed out; they already have this certificate.
schoolLevelManual.s3Tip: Select all ticks everyone eligible; Select registered goes back to the default; Clear removes all ticks.
schoolLevelManual.s4Body: Leave Download PDF when finished ticked if you want one PDF with all the new certificates, then press Generate. Stay on the page until it finishes.
schoolLevelManual.s5Body: The bar fills as certificates are generated, ten at a time, and each name shows its status. When the PDF is ready it downloads automatically; the Download PDF button lets you download it again.
schoolLevelManual.s6Body: Back on Sijil, the new certificates appear in the School Level column of the participants table. Click a participant's name to preview every certificate they have and download it.
schoolLevelManual.q1: A participant is missing from the list.
schoolLevelManual.a1: The list shows participants who match the competition's category (school level, class or age) or who are registered in it. Check the participant's class and age on the Peserta page.
schoolLevelManual.q2: I generated a certificate by mistake.
schoolLevelManual.a2: Certificates cannot be deleted from the Manager Portal. Contact the organiser to cancel it.
schoolLevelManual.q3: The name on the certificate is wrong.
schoolLevelManual.a3: Correct the name on the Peserta page before generating. For a certificate already generated, contact the organiser.
schoolLevelManual.a4: Press Download PDF after it finishes, or download each certificate from the participant's page on Sijil. Your browser may also ask to allow downloads.
